subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Take something at face value

options.text: Accept something as it looks without thinking about whether it might, in fact, not be quite what it appears
According to the appearance of something
Not laugh or change your expression even though you want to laugh
Show that you do not like something by making an unpleasant expression

solution:
The correct answer is **"Accept something as it looks without thinking about whether it might, in fact, not be quite what it appears".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **"Accept something at face value"** refers to **accepting something** for what **it is rather than extensively examining it.**

 
 
• ***Example: **After all his lying, nothing he says now should be **taken/accepted at face value.**​*
 
 
 
• The meaning of the first option is to **accept something as it is without questioning** whether **it may not be exactly what it seems to be**.
 
• Therefore the **correct answer **is **Option** **1.**
